# Lida Marsh

## Overview

- **Age:** 10  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P3](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P2](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0002), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P3](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0003)</sub>
- **Origin:** fishing village at the harbour mouth  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P2](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Lida Marsh is a ten-year-old girl who appears even younger due to her small, wizened stature. She lacks stockings, leaving her feet exposed to severe cold.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P3](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER XXV. ANOTHER SCANDAL AND ANOTHER “EXPLANATION” P27](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0027)_

## History

Lida Marsh was an impoverished girl living in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen). She received a act of charity when [Faith](../character/faith.md) gave her her shoes and last pair of nice stockings. This gift indirectly caused a local scandal, as [Faith](../character/faith.md) was left without proper legwear for church and subsequently faced criticism from the community.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P1](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P4](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0004), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P5](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P6](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0006), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV.
